us: Trump rally pledge to declare the strait US territory · GW strike group inbound
effects: Third ADNOC hit in 48 hours · Tally 62/3/2 · Gasoline $4.07
iran: Gharibabadi: 'not by a tweet, nor by an aircraft carrier'
tldr: At a New York rally Trump promised that 'pretty soon I'll be declaring the Hormuz Strait a territory of the United States,' calling the blockade 'a wall of steel.' Tehran answered within hours. A third ADNOC vessel was hit in two days as the George Washington strike group sailed to relieve the Abraham Lincoln. Fifteenth consecutive night without confirmed strikes inside Iran.

events.title: Trump pledges to declare the strait American territory
events.summary: In Nassau County: 'after we finish defeating Iran, which is being very badly defeated, pretty soon I'll be declaring the Hormuz Strait a territory of the United States.' The blockade was 'unstoppable' and 'a wall of steel.' Asked whether nine months of carrier ops was too long: 'not nearly long enough.'

events.title: Third ADNOC vessel hit in 48 hours
events.summary: ADNOC reported another of its ships attacked in the strait on the evening of August 14, no injuries — a day after drones struck the tankers Navig8 Messi and Tarif, which the UAE blamed on Iran as 'unprovoked attacks.' UKMTO separately logged a drone hit on an outbound tanker with minor damage.

events.title: George Washington strike group heads for the theater
events.summary: A US official said the carrier, which left Japan in May, is heading to relieve the USS Abraham Lincoln — 260+ days at sea, ~200 in the combat zone, 10,000 aircraft flights, 1.5 million pounds of ordnance expended.

events.title: Tehran dismisses the territory threat within hours
events.summary: Deputy FM Kazem Gharibabadi: the strait 'cannot be taken over by a tweet, nor by an aircraft carrier, nor by issuing a decree, nor by an election speech' — Iran 'neither afraid of threats nor intimidated by a show of force.' The IRGC naval commander claimed 'complete and decisive control over movements' in the strait. Baghaei kept the Oman TSS understanding separate from any reopening.

dossier: Vance framed priorities on Fox News: keeping 'oil and gas cheap for Americans' is 'goal number one,' ahead of preventing an Iranian nuclear weapon. Oil closed the week higher — Brent settled August 14 at $88.52 (+1.7%), both benchmarks up more than 5% on the week after Washington signaled the blockade could run indefinitely; US regular gasoline averaged $4.07 against $3.16 a year earlier.
